Description: Affluent customers with high spending, top order value, and frequent transactions.
Marketing_Strategy: Provide VIP loyalty rewards, exclusive early access, dedicated concierge, and premium bundles.

Description: Moderate-income shoppers showing declining engagement, infrequent orders, and high dormancy.
Marketing_Strategy: Deploy automated win-back emails, personalized reactivation coupons, and customer feedback surveys.

Description: Younger tech-savvy shoppers with moderate income and enthusiastic online shopping habits.
Marketing_Strategy: Engage through targeted social media campaigns, flash sales, gamified mobile apps, and trending drops.

Description: High-earning customers who spend conservatively with high basket size per purchase.
Marketing_Strategy: Offer high-ticket value packages, premium quality warranties, and milestone savings incentives.

Description: Price-sensitive buyers seeking seasonal discounts, clearance promotions, and essential goods.
Marketing_Strategy: Target with volume discounts, free-shipping thresholds, and affordable entry-level products.
